ValidationRule.description: Validate payment amount and require a transaction ID for successful payments
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(Payment_Amount__c), Payment_Amount__c <= 0, AND( ISPICKVAL(Payment_Status__c, "Success"), ISBLANK(Transaction_ID__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Payment amount must be greater than zero. Successful payments must have a Transaction ID.
